game_concept: A survival strategy set in Sand Dunes – Bone Valley, a valley of bleached bones: the sand ranger must handle mirage spirits while practicing debugging & combined skills. Core idea – Pseudocode Bridge: Convert plain-language pseudocode into working code steps to cross the gap.
theme: Sand Dunes – Bone Valley: a valley of bleached bones
core_gameplay_loop: In Bone Valley, repeat each round: Convert plain-language pseudocode into working code steps to cross the gap. Each round, mirage spirits strike the camel pen, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the bridge value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the camel pen from mirage spirits in Bone Valley: keep the bridge meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 29-second timer ends.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: bridge drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 29-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 9 – Debugging & Combined Skills | Level 3 (intro tier): Pseudocode Bridge
assets_style: sun-baked pixel-art desert: golden dunes, tall cacti, a bright blue oasis, warm orange shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Pseudocode Bridge' (Week 9 slot 11), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Bone Valley'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Sand Dunes
region.mood: desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how bridge changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against mirage spirits in Bone Valley.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 29 seconds while bridge > 0.
